description: The Prompt Injection Detection Benchmark (PIDB) is a comprehensive, open-source benchmark for evaluating prompt injection detection systems. It includes 643 test cases across multiple sophistication levels, covering direct attacks, RAG injection, tool calling attacks, jailbreaks, context window attacks, multilingual attacks, and over-defense testing to prevent false positives.
